description: This file defines the DataGroupPermission class within the OrangeHRM project, representing user role permissions for data groups, including methods for creating instances from arrays and querying permission attributes.

classes.name: DataGroupPermission
classes.description: Represents permissions for a user role in a data group, including read, create, update, delete, and self permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DataGroupPermission instance with specified permissions and user role.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance from a nested array defining role and permissions.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the user role associated with this permission object.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Indicates whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Indicates whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Indicates whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Indicates whether delete permission is granted.

methods.name: isSelf
methods.description: Indicates whether self permission is granted.
